_source: Project ruling R-56 (design/rules-reference.md §20, design/data-notes.md 'Counter mix'). The box's counter mix is not public and the VASSAL module has none (its palettes are unlimited, survey §3), so scripts/data/mix.ts derives one count per counter type and per Fortification kind from the game data (src/data: counters, scenarios, rsg, cards) with the rules below, and writes src/data/mix.json, the one table every counter-mix limit reads.
_rules: Named Leaders (Heroes and Privates included) are unique: 1 each.

Every other counter type of a nation: the largest of the most any one base scenario uses (both sides together, set-up and Time Track), the most any one RSG Order of Battle of its nation holds (year pieces included), and 1 if a Support Table offers it.

Elite, Line and Green Teams, which Deploy (§E52, §8.2) and Light Wounds (§A36) take from the mix: that, plus the Teams one pass through the nation's Fate deck can make (teamsPerCard: 1 per Light Wounds Action, 2 per Deploy Event).

Fortification markers (no nation): the most any base scenario sets up (pre-placed ones included) or any one RSG Fortification OB holds, plus the most one pass through the two Fate decks of a base-game pairing can place during play (fortPlacers; a Scenario Defender Action counts in one deck only). The Pillbox is unique (fixed: the rules say there is one).
notInMix: Smoke: the 50 Smoke chits of src/data/counters.json smokeMix (the module's draw pile), drawn at random and returned when removed (state.ts smokeCup).
Objective chits: the 22 chits A-X (no I, O), drawn from the cup (state.ts chitCup).
Blaze: no limit. No source gives a count, Blazes never leave the map, and Breeze can spread them any number of times; a cap would need a ruling on which Blazes spread first.
Suppressed and Veteran markers: no limit (at most one of each per unit, §8.1).
The Spotting Round: one, on the map or not (state.ts spottingRound).
